purpose: measure request-mask-bounded Direct-HDR repair using the original full camera projection, GL scissor, and partial HDR readback
roi_rule: per-frame tight integer bounding box of the current candidate unknown/request mask; no GT used to select or size the ROI

render_path.camera: existing fixed main camera at native resolution and projection
render_path.rasterization: full scene with the original depth test, clipped by OpenGL scissor to the request bounding box
render_path.readback: partial MSAA color blit and scene-linear HDR readback for the same ROI
render_path.repaired_values: only pixels explicitly marked unknown by the candidate reconstruction

audit.compare: every scissor HDR sample against same-state full-frame HDR at the exact same pixel
audit.direct_cost: measure full-resolution HDR-only rendering plus DVS on the same saved trace rows
audit.candidate_cost: prior K source/preparation/reconstruction timings plus fresh scissor HDR-only repair and fresh DVS; label as assembled estimate
